matched_scada_weather_baseline.interpretation: Same targets and lead weighting as archived model; baseline uses measured future SCADA weather and is an optimistic diagnostic, not a deployable historical forecast.

result.inference_limitation: Validation covers approximately 24h and 48h issue-time leads; other hours within the 1-48h production horizon have not been separately validated.
result.lead_time_semantics: valid_time - issue_time within +/-3h of 24h or 48h; model-run age is separately recorded. Both lead groups are pooled, not selected against unequal holdouts.
result.selection_basis: lowest clipped January MAE on identical pooled rows available by Jan31 00:00 station time; later January targets are reporting-only; January targets are never used for fitting

archived_weather_description: Open-Meteo Single Runs ECMWF IFS cached forecast values only. Every row uses a run available by issue_time under a 6-hour publication delay policy; actual weather and pre-operational cycle hindcasts are never substituted.
lead_time_semantics: Forecast lead is valid_time - issue_time. Only cached rows within +/-3h of 24h or 48h are eligible; both available lead groups are pooled.

scada_weather_baseline.important_limitation: Historical measured-SCADA-weather baseline only; production inference must use archived weather forecasts available at issue time.

turbine_1.important_limitation: Historical measured-SCADA-weather baseline only; production inference must use archived weather forecasts available at issue time.
turbine_1.selection_basis: lowest clipped January 2026 validation MAE among sklearn regressors
turbine_1.timestamp_convention: Source SCADA calendar; timezone is not assumed to be UTC.
